summary: Iteration 2 tested 3 new features (Provider Photo Upload, Bulk CSV Import, Saved Providers) + light regression. Backend: 7/7 new-feature pytest passed (auth required, non-image rejection, upload + serve image bytes, image URL persisted on provider, bulk-import auth required, 2-row CSV creates 2 providers with correct types/lists, invalid rows skipped with errors). Frontend Playwright: admin login → dashboard, image upload testids visible in provider/articles/events forms, uploading a 1x1 PNG populates field-image_url with full REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/files/... and GET returns 200 image/png; CSV Import dialog with template + file input creates 2 providers, visible on /directory; heart save-provider-<i> toggles saved-count badge on header-saved-link, /saved shows saved providers, persists across reload, unsave decrements; save-provider-detail on provider detail toggles header count; directory search regression works. All frontend flows PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: Saved.jsx first requests GET /api/provider/{id} (singular) which 404s, then falls back to /providers/{id}. Consider removing the singular fallback to avoid noisy 404s in network tab.

ImageField hard-codes 'multipart/form-data' Content-Type header; axios sets it automatically with boundary — passing manually can occasionally break in some setups. Currently works, but best-practice is to let axios/browser set it.
bulk_import_providers ignores unknown CSV columns silently — good — but does not de-duplicate on name; repeat uploads create duplicates. Consider optional upsert/dedupe.

Uploaded image URL is stored as absolute REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/files/... — locks records to the current preview host. Storing relative /api/files/<path> and resolving on the client would be more portable.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up: UI_TEST_UploadProv, UI_BULK_A, UI_BULK_B. Uploaded a 1x1 PNG to Emergent object storage (path healthlink/providers/<uuid>.png) — files intentionally left in storage; DB record left in files collection (small, acceptable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New testids: field-image_url-upload, field-image_url-file, field-image_url; import-csv-btn, import-csv-dialog, download-template-btn, import-file-input, run-import-btn, import-result; save-provider-<i>, save-provider-detail, header-saved-link, saved-count, saved-grid. Admin form add/save buttons follow pattern add-<entity>-btn / save-<entity>-btn where entity is plural (add-providers-btn, save-providers-btn). Saved state lives client-side in localStorage 'hl_saved'; /saved fetches each id via /api/providers/{id}.
